_comment: Which RenderBackend entry point serves each D3D8 method the engine reaches, and which
of them are the Vulkan backend's job at all. This is the only hand-maintained input to
backend-coverage-scan.py: it is a design statement, not a measurement. The *status* of
every entry named here is measured from src/render_backend.h and src/vulkan_backend.cpp,
so a name that does not exist reads as `absent` rather than as coverage.
backend       the Vulkan backend has to serve it; counted in the coverage figure
caps          a capability query, answered once at device creation (zh-feature-probe
and caps_probe.cpp measure the device's real caps) rather than per call
platform      belongs to the window/display/cursor seam, not the renderer
device-model  a D3D8 device-model artefact (device loss, managed-pool eviction) with
no Vulkan analogue and nothing to implement behind the seam
Every method the engine reaches must appear here or the scan fails, so a newly reached
D3D8 method cannot slip in unclassified.

CopyRects.note: surface-to-surface blit; the shadow and screenshot paths use it

CreateAdditionalSwapChain.note: second swapchain for a second window; the window seam owns swapchains

CreateImageSurface.note: system-memory surface, the staging half of CopyRects/UpdateTexture

CreateCubeTexture.note: reached only through D3DXCreateCubeTexture() off Windows; no backend entry point exists yet, so this reads as absent

CreatePixelShader.note: the 16 in-repo ps.1.1/vs.1.1 shaders; not started

CreateVertexBuffer.note: FVF 0 creates an untyped buffer whose layout is the FVF bound at draw time

CreateVertexShader.note: vs.1.1 token stream translated; the D3DVSD_* declaration is decoded to the stream layout untyped (FVF 0) buffers are drawn with under the program (one stream, FLOAT1-4/D3DCOLOR; SKIP, UBYTE4, SHORT2/4 and extra streams refused loudly)

CreateVolumeTexture.note: reached only through D3DXCreateVolumeTexture() off Windows; no backend entry point exists yet, so this reads as absent

DrawIndexedPrimitive.note: primitive-type coverage is measured separately, see primitive_types

DrawPrimitive.note: non-indexed; W3DSnow's point-sprite batches are the engine's use

DrawPrimitiveUP.note: every engine site draws a 2-triangle strip from stack vertices

GetBackBuffer.note: the engine takes the back buffer to read pixels out of it

LightEnable.note: Set_Light(index, nullptr) is D3D8's LightEnable(index, FALSE)

ProcessVertices.note: CPU-side transform of a vertex buffer; the mesh-shadow path uses it

SetRenderState.note: per-state coverage is the render_states table, not this one method

SetStreamSource.note: the explicit stride is honoured for untyped (FVF 0) buffers

SetTextureStageState.note: per-state coverage is the stage_states table

SetVertexShader.note: an FVF token here selects fixed function; a typed buffer carries its own FVF, an untyped one draws with this

UpdateTexture.note: managed-pool sysmem-to-video copy; the lock/unlock path uploads directly instead
